scripts.prebuild: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && prisma generate && tsc && node ../../scripts/generate-tenant-bootstrap-ledger-manifest.mjs --root ../.. --output dist/tenant-bootstrap/owner-migrations.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:deps && prisma generate && tsc --noEmit
scripts.coverage: npm run build && c8 --all --src dist --extension .js --exclude "**/*.test.js" --exclude "**/generated/**" --exclude "**/testing/**" --reporter lcov --reporter text node --test --test-concurrency=1 "dist/**/*.test.js"
